text:
You need an AI automation website that lets users upload a file to their profile and automatically share that document to multiple sites.

I’m Noor Halden, and I build Python-based automation and AI workflows. With 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, NLP, and tools like LangChain and the OpenAI API, I can help design and implement this kind of document-sharing flow cleanly and reliably.

One relevant project was Private wiki question answering for Strata Engineering Group, where I built an on-premise assistant over 14k pages of engineering standards using Python, LlamaIndex, Qdrant, Ollama, Llama 3, and FastAPI. It achieved an 82% top-3 hit rate on 60 engineer questions, with zero external API calls.

For your site, I can focus on the upload, processing, and multi-site distribution logic.

Which sites should the uploaded document be shared to, and do they each have their own API or posting method?
